title: Shiraishi An — BBQ With Everyone♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The next morning
Campground

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
An, wake up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mhm... No... It's still cold...
Let's sleep in a little more, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Shinonome and Aoyagi are up already.
It looks like they're getting started on breakfast too, so we should probably get going, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Okay, I guess you're right...
Camp Spigot

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Eep! It's freezing...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Can't you wash up a little quieter?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, don't blame me!
I thought my hands were gonna freeze off just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To her credit, the water is surprisingly cold. My hands hurt after trying to wash them just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
See?!
I could almost feel my fingers snapping off.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... Oh, that means...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You two have the same idea of what it's like to be startled after touching really cold water during the morning in winter, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. We know the pain of having our hands exposed to freezing water during a cold day in the mountains, so we'd be able to sync up well there...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I've never heard of a song like that...
But I guess it is important to see and feel the same things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's right!
Experience counts for everything!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we're done putting away the dishes. How are you guys doing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, Shinonome. We're just about done too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've thrown away the paper plates we used for the sandwiches. To be honest, I'm still amazed at how good they were.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? My dad taught me how to make them♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But what do we do now...?
We still have some time to kill before checkout.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. We could... Practice?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not a bad idea... But I feel like we should do something that we can only do here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We could take another walk in the forest again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure it's very different during the day, and more importantly, we won't get lost.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds nice.
Let's go!
In the forest

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The trail seems much fainter the second time around. Do you think we should put down some markers just in case?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, we're not picking plants or anything like last time, so I doubt we'll lose track of where we are.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll make sure to keep an eye on where we go this time!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That isn't very reassuring coming from you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: FYI, it's actually pretty hard for me to get lost. Plus, I know how to read maps!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, this forest does seem a little different compared to yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's still very serene, and the air feels just as clean as last time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it feels much damper today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's probably because of all the morning dew.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We could get a completely different kind of song if we use this as inspiration.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we try singing here with that in mind?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I bet we'll sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Campground

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, it's almost time for checkout.
We should get ready to go...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... Still, it's a shame...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I would've liked to stay another night...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You know what they say, Toya.
A field trip's not over until you get home.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Tsukasa's told me that quite a few times...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually don't really agree with that saying.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You don't?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, because you'll get home and start talking about what happened, which only makes you want to go on it again, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I think it should be, The field trip goes on after you get home!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Even after you get home.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That means this trip will never end as long as we keep talking and reminiscing about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Bullseye!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold on. I thought people say that to make sure you actually get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, what you say also kinda makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree!
It's like we get to keep camping after we get home!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. So let's all get ready to go!
